steps.en: Install the seven packages from the repo
Implement the role interface over your catalog, cart and orders
steps.zh: 用你的目录、购物车、订单实现角色接口

steps.en: Build the agent with your backend and the shipped skill flows
steps.zh: 用你的 backend 和自带 skill 流程构造 agent

steps.en: Expose the two routes your app calls
steps.zh: 在你的应用里暴露两个路由

steps.en: Runs the turn loop: tools dispatch, gates check provenance, card values are joined from your records
steps.zh: 跑 turn loop：工具分发、来源闸门校验、卡片值由你的记录回填

steps.en: Streams the turn back as events your UI renders
steps.zh: 把这一轮以事件流回吐给你的 UI 渲染

value.en: You build once; every turn afterwards gets prompt, guardrails, UI fill-in and turn loop for free
value.zh: 你只搭一次；之后每一轮对话都白拿 prompt、护栏、UI 回填和 turn loop

sources: README 'Quick start: run the demos' (pip install -r requirements.txt installs the seven packages from their directories)

README 'Three ways to run an agent' (ShoppingAgent(backend=your_backend, skills_dir=Path("shopping-agent/skills"), config=ShoppingAgentConfig(brand_name="Your Store")); hosts take the session id in an X-Session-Id header; events text_delta, tool_call, ui, cart_update, turn_complete)
README 'The two agents' (a deployment implements StorefrontBackend over catalog/cart/order/policy and MerchantBackend over analytics/catalog/inventory/pricing/campaigns)
docs/safety.md (rules enforced inside the tool call hold on all three paths; cart provenance, server-authored disclosures, host approval for merchant writes)
